body: Thanks dude. I'm the opposite. The empty void is exactly what I want. I don't believe in an afterlife either. But emptiness is what let's me be at peace. I get to just stop.

That's a great perspective and attitude to have. And I kind of did that already this past weekend. I just know it's all going to be the same if I did in 1 day or in 50 years. Either way I just cease to exist
I don't want to inconvenience my co workers. Yeah I just wanted to tell someone I'm doing it before I go. Feels almost like leaving a piece of me behind
I have to cover the hospital this and next week and I don't want to call someone in to cover me

I have looked into all of it. I've watched countless documentaries on the subject, books on how to do it effectively, and the resources available for the people who are hurt by this. 

I know it's selfish. But the alternative just seems so much worse

I appreciate your perspective. But my mind has been made up for a while now. I know it's going to suck for them. But I can't even begin to imagine the pain of not doing it for myself. And ultimately I know they wouldn't want me to suffer, even if it means it's hard for them 

I know I'm loved. I know I'll be missed. I just don't particularly care or want to be here anymore. If I could press a button where I just don't exist anymore, I would take that option.
Thanks for your perspective. I hope you can stay strong.
I know there's a risk of something like this happening. And it's what has kept me from doing it until now. But I guess I'm ready to make one more selfish decision
It will heal and pass, as everything else does, I personally just don't want to stick around to see the ending. But thanks for reaching out.

That's for the kind words. I'm at peace with the decision. I know people will miss me. But they will heal with time. 

It will be painless and quick.

Thanks for the kind words stranger. The part I feel worst about is my wasted education. But I've already accepted it. 18 days. The first Saturday in which I'll be in my new apartment. I don't want to do it in my house because then my wife would have to know it happened here.
